modmenu.descriptionTranslation.alaindust: Ala Industrial — an EU/FE tech mod for Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric and NeoForge). Build an industrial power grid with wind, solar and water generators, cables and a Battery Box, run ore through macerators, extractors and an electric furnace, mine four new metals — tin, silver, nickel and uranium — and store it all in the Iron Chest. LV tier ready, MV/HV planned.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.alaindustrial: EU/FE tech mod (Fabric + NeoForge): power grid, ore processing, four new metals and storage.
